manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Selvala enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
